prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional ATFM+A-CDM; airports Meridian International(=Meridian Regional Airport), Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport. Business Rules Registry(BRR): thresholds, connection/gate/towing/stand/swap rules, border states, CTT tolerance, freeze horizon, tie-breaker. Modes: Normal; Adverse Weather; Capacity Reduction(binding metering; RFM may suspend swaps); Recovery; Slot Compliance; Winter(MBO confirms); Contingency Fallback(ADM declares after RFM, Tower Supervisor, SSE). Fallback: Foxglove down→Digital Briefing Room; Marlinstone/CAM unreliable→last verified Airport Capacity Plan(ACP); Blueharbor down→Slot Coordinator manual sheet at Contingency Operations Console, keeps last CTT; revised CTT needs Tower Supervisor+Ramp Control Lead, AOC readback; Ironleaf advisory; Emberline monitor-only. On restore Regional Flow Platform(RFP) reconciles with Collaborative Decision Log(CDL). AOC sends Passenger Misconnect Count→Airline Interface Adapter; Departure Metering Service recommends; Tower Supervisor may reject. Identity Access Service(IAS) authoritative roles; no shared accounts; least privilege; temporary access needs sponsor/purpose/scope/expiry. Roles: Tower Supervisor runs Tower Sequence Manager(TSM); Ramp Control Lead runs Ramp Movement Board(RMB); AOC, Aircraft Operator Rep submit only; SSE admin. No single user creates+approves+conceals GDP/AAR/Tactical Regulation Proposal changes; RFP records initiator/approver/object/time. Emergency access(Emergency Response Coordinator, ADM, SSE) via Silverpine needs IAS incident ref+expiry, post-review. Audit Event Ledger logs auth, privileges, approvals, config, exports, emergency access, slot compliance; Time Synchronization Service source; Performance Analytics Warehouse can't alter. Compliance compares CTT/TOBT/AOBT/ATOT; Slot Compliance State: compliant/early/late/exempted/substituted/cancelled/pending review. Freeze-horizon changes need reason code, visible to RFM. TSM, RMB provide actual milestones; Surface Surveillance Adapter evidence retained; Capacity Assessment Module changes correlated with active ACP/AAR. Warehouse aggregates compliance by carrier/route group/regulation/config/time band, role-restricted. Data Governance Steward verifies audit fields; SSE investigates gaps. RFM attributes noncompliance via Post Operations Report; ADM reviews late airport changes; findings adjust tolerances/reason codes/training under change control. Ownership

New part:
S819: The Meteorology Briefing Officer shall own operational weather classification inputs accepted by the Weather Ingest Gateway.
S820: The Airline Operations Coordinator shall be accountable for airline-supplied schedule intent, readiness status, and Target Off Block Time updates submitted through approved interfaces.
S821: Each owned data element shall have a defined business meaning, allowed value range, update authority, retention class, and escalation contact.
S822: Freshness indicators shall be displayed on the Common Situation Display wherever stale data could affect sequencing, metering, regulation, or resource allocation decisions.
S823: The freshness indicator shall include the time of last accepted update, the maximum permitted age, and a visual state that distinguishes current, aging, stale, and unavailable data.
S824: The Time Synchronization Service shall provide the common time basis used for freshness calculations across the Regional Flow Platform.
S825: The Demand Prediction Service, Capacity Assessment Module, Slot Allocation Engine, and Departure Metering Service shall reject data that lacks a trusted timestamp.
S826: Validation rules shall include schema checks, mandatory field checks, code set checks, temporal sequence checks, and operational plausibility checks.
S827: The Flight Data Exchange shall validate Flight Intent Message content before the data is made available for operational use.
S828: The Surface Surveillance Adapter shall apply position quality checks and shall mark uncertain observations before they are used by surface decision functions.
S829: The Airline Interface Adapter shall apply carrier-specific format checks while preserving the common operational meaning required by the Regional Flow Platform.
S830: The Handling Resource Planner shall validate resource quantities, task timing, and allocation identifiers against active operational reference data.
S831: The Business Rules Registry shall hold the current validation thresholds, allowable reason codes, and exception rules approved for Normal Operations, Adverse Weather Mode, Capacity Reduction State, Recovery Phase, and Contingency Fallback State.
S832: When a discrepancy is detected, the affected component shall mark the data as disputed and shall preserve the prior accepted value until an authorized correction is available.
S833: The Data Governance Steward shall coordinate discrepancy resolution with the responsible operational owner and shall record the disposition in the Audit Event Ledger.
S834: Urgent discrepancies that could change a metering, arrival regulation, or slot allocation decision shall be raised through the Alert Distribution Hub and reviewed in the Digital Briefing Room.
S835: The System Support Engineer shall investigate technical causes of missing, delayed, duplicated, or transformed records and shall provide evidence needed for stewardship decisions.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
